title: Peer path
description: How a logical application peer is currently reachable. The transition vocabulary matters more than the values: `PeerConnected` fires only when a peer goes from NO usable application connection to at least one, so a successful DCUtR hole punch on an already-connected relayed peer emits `PeerPathChanged { relayed -> direct }` and NOT a second `PeerConnected`. Treating the upgrade as a new connection would double-count peers and re-run whatever a consumer does on first contact.
